# Explore heterogeneity across model subsets with GOSH diagnostics

Development-snapshot manual for apm_gosh. The roxygen source in R/ is
authoritative; regenerate with roxygen2 during local validation.

## Usage

``` r
apm_gosh(...)
```

## Arguments

- ...:

  See the complete roxygen documentation and vignettes for arguments and
  method-specific assumptions.

## Value

An auditable agriPairMetaFlow result or output object as documented in
the function source.

## Examples

``` r
# Example 1: lightweight pedagogical GOSH run.
apm_gosh(apm_fit(agri_effects_benchmark), subsets=100, seed=1, plot=FALSE)
#> <apm_gosh> subsets=100 | seed=1
#>  k        QE          I2       H2         tau2        tau     estimate
```
